apps.notes: No in-house source repo exists. The chart deployment uses ghcr.io/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp directly. Per ownership conventions, a repackaged/upstream image is modelled as an upstream product owned by the DEPLOYER (HelmCharts), not onboarded as a new producer. The chart's architecture.yaml comment ('source lives in its own repo (future producer)') is inaccurate. Recommend: drop from producer-onboarding scope; fix in helm-charts as ss:/app: upstream product. Needs your call.
